classes.purpose: Identify the account and its recorded US customer declaration.
classes.currentRetention: Retained while the account exists; eligibility cascades. Other tables can prevent account deletion.
classes.proposedRetention: Active account; ordinary personal fields enter closure purge. Only justified minimal proof survives in a separate restricted receipt.
classes.deletionAuthority: Recently authenticated owner confirms exact account closure; restricted preservation review precedes purge.
classes.exportPolicy: Allowlist account identifier, email, creation time and customer declaration. Exclude password hashes/salts and recovery secrets.

classes.purpose: Owner authentication, invitation redemption and replay prevention; unused invitations/challenges may have no account.
classes.currentRetention: Expiry checks deny stale sessions/challenges. Challenges are consumed/pruned during auth. Invitations.used_by has NO ACTION; auth_challenges has no ownership FK. No general identity-retention sweeper.
classes.proposedRetention: Revoke sessions and open challenges on closure; retain only closure-cancel authentication during any approved grace period. Remove credential material at purge. Expired unclaimed auth material is independently swept.
classes.deletionAuthority: Owner security controls or reviewed account closure; operator manages unclaimed invitations. Never infer erasure solely from a missing FK.
classes.exportPolicy: Credential names and creation/last-use metadata only; omit public-key material, credential IDs, hashes, codes, challenges and bearer tokens.

classes.purpose: Profile/name/bio/photo, welcome progress, saved workspace tabs and preferences.
classes.currentRetention: Account-linked storage; profile photo bytes are in D1 and replacement clears the current safety receipt. No age-based profile/chat-memory expiry.
classes.proposedRetention: Retain while active or until explicit replacement/removal; ordinary closure purge includes agent-context copies. Pending/blocked images follow restricted safety review, never ordinary export.
classes.deletionAuthority: Owner profile/workspace edits; exact account closure plus safety-case coordination for held images.
classes.exportPolicy: Allowlist profile, preferences and workflow configuration. Include uploaded photo only with valid current checks; omit auth and internal safety references.

classes.purpose: Project identity, brief, preferences and ownership root.
classes.currentRetention: No customer whole-project/account deletion workflow. Project rows own many cascades and external-resource references.
classes.proposedRetention: Keep while active; close admissions and withdraw service before deletion. Preserve minimal resource/operation receipts independently until settled.
classes.deletionAuthority: Exact recently authenticated owner project/account review; models cannot confirm deletion.
classes.exportPolicy: Project ID, brief and user-facing settings; a manifest lists included versions/resources and any omissions.

classes.purpose: Conversation continuity, saved agent inspection results and action history.
classes.currentRetention: Retained under account; current Chat transcript has an upper revision but is not a whole-account snapshot. Internal inspections and receipts can outlive visible messages.
classes.proposedRetention: Retain active-account conversation until an approved user removal/retention policy; ordinary closure purge includes inspections and copied context. Extract only necessary unresolved-operation metadata first.
classes.deletionAuthority: Owner closure or future reviewed conversation deletion; do not delete referenced authority/operation evidence without migration.
classes.exportPolicy: Saved user/assistant turns and customer action summaries at a stable cutoff. Exclude private operator material and internal inspection dumps.

classes.purpose: Immutable site artifacts, publication authority, comparisons and removal receipts.
classes.currentRetention: Up to 25 saved versions; exact removal reviews, live/review/backup dependency guards, no automatic age pruning. Applied removal metadata prevents same-ID recreation.
classes.proposedRetention: Active content until explicit removal/closure; keep non-content deletion tombstones independently of the deleted account and every restore candidate. Unpublish before purge.
classes.deletionAuthority: Exact owner version/project/account review; check live and external-backup dependencies at commit time.
classes.exportPolicy: Owned source/config/HTML and provenance, subject to current content/media clearance. Export is not automatic publication permission.

classes.purpose: Private project JPEG metadata/reference graph and queued physical R2 cleanup.
classes.currentRetention: Referenced photos retained; reviewed unused-photo removal queues object keys. Daily cleanup waits one hour and uses a bounded orphan pass. file_cleanup has no owner FK.
classes.proposedRetention: Retain referenced approved objects until removal/closure. Keep a private owner/object deletion manifest until R2 deletion and orphan reconciliation are confirmed; no ordinary export of held media.
classes.deletionAuthority: Owner exact photo/closure review plus safety hold check; worker performs only previously authorized object cleanup.
classes.exportPolicy: Approved JPEG bytes and safe metadata only; do not expose R2 keys, held content or scanner references.

classes.purpose: Exact-byte policy requirements, approval expiry and scanner-attempt identity.
classes.currentRetention: Bounded ledgers; expiry blocks serving but is not physical cleanup. Owner/file cascades and profile replacement can remove evidence. No restricted preservation store or live scanner.
classes.proposedRetention: Retain current decisions while the artifact can be used; terminal routine checks get a reviewed 90-day metadata schedule. Open cases/unknown scans move to restricted handling before ordinary deletion.
classes.deletionAuthority: Dedicated lifecycle/safety operator; a model verdict, owner closure or low risk score cannot release a legal preservation hold.
classes.exportPolicy: Customer-facing availability/decision summaries where permitted; no authority hashes, detector internals, restricted evidence or suspected-illegal bytes.

classes.purpose: Reviewed incident provenance and immutable corrections used for risk sampling.
classes.currentRetention: No age purge; ordinary scoring decay does not delete evidence. Account cascade currently removes rows. No independent legal-hold store.
classes.proposedRetention: Routine closed-case metadata: proposed 90 days after resolution, subject to counsel/privacy review. Statutory/legal cases: case-specific basis, scope, deadline and extension; no blanket permanent retention.
classes.deletionAuthority: Named restricted case operator with required legal review and audited release; owner/agent cannot independently destroy held evidence.
classes.exportPolicy: Separate lawful access/appeal process; general account bundle excludes raw evidence, reviewer references and operational risk internals.

classes.purpose: Untrusted imported source awaiting policy/security admission.
classes.currentRetention: Stored source/digest/triage state; hourly triage never approves. No age cleanup; owner/project deletion cascades.
classes.proposedRetention: Ordinary abandoned pending imports: proposed seven days after last user activity, after ruling out open scan/case preservation. Never activate or export held source to bypass admission.
classes.deletionAuthority: Owner removal/closure or approved quarantine policy, after restricted-case review.
classes.exportPolicy: Manifest may report a held import without bytes. Only separately cleared artifacts may enter normal code exports.

classes.purpose: Structured directory records, public snapshots and exact change/export authority.
classes.currentRetention: Current draft/live data and immutable reviews remain with project; no age purge of review payloads.
classes.proposedRetention: Active records until explicit removal/closure; strip duplicate obsolete snapshot payloads only after preserving required receipt identity. Reapply record deletion on restores.
classes.deletionAuthority: Exact owner mutation/closure review; identify third-party personal data and lawful request routing.
classes.exportPolicy: Owned directory snapshots/records in a separately labeled project-data section, with current safety/privacy authorization.

classes.purpose: Customer contact inbox and form admission/idempotency.
classes.currentRetention: Submissions expire after 30 days; inbox hides expired data and daily maintenance removes expired submissions/receipts. Settings and review metadata are separate.
classes.proposedRetention: Keep the existing 30-day message window unless explicitly changed. Closure disables intake immediately, purges ordinary content and retains only justified anti-replay metadata.
classes.deletionAuthority: Project owner controls inbox; visitor privacy requests need verified scoped handling. Customer closure never authorizes transfer to an unrelated account.
classes.exportPolicy: Separate explicitly requested visitor-data export; not default platform profile export, agent context or public site source ZIP.

classes.purpose: Bounded backend source, tests, state, saved snapshots and live authority.
classes.currentRetention: Account/project-linked artifacts and immutable review/operation metadata; some authority references block cascades. Backend snapshots may duplicate submitted personal data.
classes.proposedRetention: Active artifacts until removal/closure; disable execution and form ingress first. Settle dispatched work; scrub current and snapshot copies and keep minimum replay/deletion metadata separately.
classes.deletionAuthority: Exact owner source/state/closure review; worker outcomes cannot authorize new external effects during closure.
classes.exportPolicy: Cleared source/tests and compatibility manifest; private state requires separate explicit data scope. Never include secrets or execute source while exporting.

classes.purpose: Opt-in reuse nomination and provenance of platform-authored reusable components.
classes.currentRetention: Nomination/provenance follows referenced backend version/account. Not an independently approved cross-user code publishing pipeline.
classes.proposedRetention: Withdraw pending nominations on closure. Any future shared release must have separate reviewed sanitized/licensed provenance and a removal/correction process independent of private tenant source.
classes.deletionAuthority: Owner withdraws nomination; authorized maintainer handles already accepted generic artifacts under separate license/safety review.
classes.exportPolicy: Customer code's component/license provenance; never another customer's source or nomination data.

classes.purpose: Per-project visitor identity, invitation/session access and erasure replay receipts.
classes.currentRetention: Visitor deletion removes linked live/recovery data through explicit guards/triggers; expiring replay receipts are cleaned daily. NO ACTION references require coordinated cleanup.
classes.proposedRetention: Revoke access immediately on reviewed erasure/closure. Retain minimal durable suppression independently of account cascades through every allowed backup/restore window; short replay receipts alone are insufficient.
classes.deletionAuthority: Fresh visitor self-service or exact owner per-visitor review; platform closure must reconcile all visitors in the project.
classes.exportPolicy: Visitor's own identity/document/history via authenticated visitor flow; owner account bundles omit credentials, recovery material and default visitor datasets.

classes.purpose: Visitor documents, bounded transition outcomes, application configuration and execution authority.
classes.currentRetention: Visitor/app state and operation history; daily usage older than 35 days is pruned by UTC day. Multiple immutable review references block deletion.
classes.proposedRetention: Application content remains while active; erasure covers result/next-state copies as well as current document. Non-content operation receipts survive only for defined replay/reconciliation needs.
classes.deletionAuthority: Visitor erasure/owner reviewed app deletion or closure, with exact project/visitor ownership and publication withdrawal.
classes.exportPolicy: Separate scoped visitor export; optional owner app-data export needs explicit authority and format selection. Existing visitor stream is not a globally consistent restore snapshot.

classes.purpose: App migration staging, recovery copies, cancellation and rollback authority.
classes.currentRetention: Stale staging is removed daily; applied/cancelled checks clear staging. Recovery points require explicit removal; ten active per app, no age-based backup expiry.
classes.proposedRetention: Backups and user-visible saved recovery points must be distinguished. Proposed 30-day maximum for managed backup copies; retained user recovery points must be scrubbed for visitor erasures before serving/restoring.
classes.deletionAuthority: Exact owner recovery-point/closure review; erasure suppression overrides recovery content. Restricted holds never make a snapshot publicly usable.
classes.exportPolicy: Separately labeled recovery data only with explicit scope and suppression applied; never export erased visitors from old snapshots.

classes.purpose: Customer-authorized provider access and durable credential revocation.
classes.currentRetention: Encrypted credentials retained for pending revocation until confirmed or expired; OAuth expiry cleanup. Account cascades can destroy revocation authority prematurely.
classes.proposedRetention: Cancel callbacks/new consent on closure; revoke credentials before deleting ciphertext/key access. Keep unresolved revocation work in isolated minimal closure records, without preserving unrelated customer content.
classes.deletionAuthority: Customer disconnect/closure authorizes access revocation, not deleting repositories/zones. Operator reconciles failed revocation.
classes.exportPolicy: Provider names, customer connection status and selected resource metadata only. Never tokens, ciphertext, PKCE verifier, auth state or encryption material.

classes.purpose: Immutable reviewed source-backup intent, committed destination and uncertain-write reconciliation.
classes.currentRetention: Receipt retains source version; unresolved dispatch and private files_json can remain. External repository commits survive disconnect and platform deletion.
classes.proposedRetention: Settle unknown outcomes; minimize payload after preserving necessary receipt. Customer-owned repository/commits remain under customer control; no implicit deletion or history rewrite.
classes.deletionAuthority: Owner-reviewed backup initially; any external removal is a separate exact approval and capability. Closure only revokes Whumpo access.
classes.exportPolicy: Customer destination/commit/status and own artifact; exclude credentials/provider raw errors. Explain external copies separately.

classes.purpose: Owned-domain verification, reviewed DNS and custom-hosting serving authority.
classes.currentRetention: Unknown provider operations are retained; RESTRICT references intentionally block cascades. Verification tokens and provider IDs may remain in receipts.
classes.proposedRetention: Stop Whumpo serving and reconcile owned custom-hostname detach. Retain minimum unknown-operation/proof metadata until settled. Never cancel registration, delete a zone or remove unrelated DNS implicitly.
classes.deletionAuthority: Exact owner routing/disconnect/removal review plus provider ownership evidence; customer zone/repository ownership remains external.
classes.exportPolicy: Hostname, intended configuration and customer-visible receipts; omit proof tokens, operational identifiers and internal reconciliation notes.

classes.purpose: Platform-managed CMS Worker, database, private media bucket, session namespace and binding/key identities.
classes.currentRetention: Control records and provider resources have different lifecycles; deleting rows does not delete resources. Some registrations/cross-references prevent cascades.
classes.proposedRetention: Keep exact resource manifest and key authority until withdrawal, export, restricted preservation and confirmed teardown finish. Isolate per-project resources; shared platform resources must never be deleted.
classes.deletionAuthority: Owner exact CMS/project/closure review plus operator resource ownership reconciliation. CMS testing remains owner-deferred.
classes.exportPolicy: Customer content/configuration manifest, not provider credentials, secret digests or executable provisioning authority.

classes.purpose: CMS draft/edit bodies, frozen HTML/snapshots, public and private article references.
classes.currentRetention: Immutable content/operation receipts without general TTL; account/project/native-CMS copies differ and some FKs block deletion.
classes.proposedRetention: Active content until removal/closure. Withdraw all native/frozen surfaces and apply artifact-wide safety/erasure rules before exporting or scrubbing every duplicate.
classes.deletionAuthority: Exact owner content/discard/unpublish/closure review; no automatic native CMS acceptance or resource teardown.
classes.exportPolicy: Cleared content, revisions and taxonomy in a portable project section; existing draft downloads are not whole-CMS exports.

classes.purpose: Private CMS images, WordPress XML, imported taxonomy/media plans and publication manifests.
classes.currentRetention: Control metadata plus native R2/D1 copies; no complete safety admission or retained-byte cleanup policy. Some FKs restrict resource deletion.
classes.proposedRetention: Pending imports use the proposed bounded quarantine policy after case review. Approved media follows references; closure must remove raw XML, native bytes, frozen copies and thumbnails/derivatives where present.
classes.deletionAuthority: Exact owner removal/closure plus mandatory safety and case checks. Do not infer cleared status from an existing CMS receipt.
classes.exportPolicy: Only cleared exact media/content; held imports appear as omission status, never a bypass through raw-download endpoints.

classes.purpose: Non-billable standard request replay, provider dispatch/cost receipts and internal test budgets.
classes.currentRetention: Immutable account/Chat-linked receipts; uncertain dispatch holds remain. No general terminal-history purge; some internal acknowledgment text is stored.
classes.proposedRetention: Keep minimum unresolved-operation metadata until confirmed. Proposed 90-day terminal diagnostics; scrub content/acknowledgments at closure and retain only justified aggregate economics.
classes.deletionAuthority: Owner closure plus trusted outcome reconciliation; do not erase an unknown spend or invent zero usage.
classes.exportPolicy: Customer request status and timing/token metadata where exposed; standard AI remains zero customer credits. Exclude internal costs, provider auth and operator diagnostics.

classes.purpose: Plan preferences, historical test usage, checkout idempotency and customer financial rights.
classes.currentRetention: Most records cascade; immutable receipt rules and uncertain holds limit ad-hoc deletion. Stripe is disconnected; these are not evidence of live paid subscriptions.
classes.proposedRetention: Ordinary preferences are purged; unsettled payments/refunds/credits require resolution. Minimum real invoice/transaction records use a separately approved accountant/legal schedule; no guessed tax-retention term.
classes.deletionAuthority: Owner closure starts cancellation/settlement; qualified finance operator decides required minimal record retention. Closure cannot silently forfeit balances.
classes.exportPolicy: Customer plan/credit/usage/payment history with explanatory test/live status; no provider secrets, other tenants or private margin data.

classes.purpose: Inactive funded-inference reservations, immutable result/receipt identity and account/platform budgets.
classes.currentRetention: RESTRICT references intentionally retain spend/result records; scopes can include global budgets. API/Gateway provider dispatch is not active.
classes.proposedRetention: Never release unknown reservations on closure. Move minimum receipt authority to a reviewed restricted financial lifecycle, scrub result payloads, preserve aggregate platform budgets independently.
classes.deletionAuthority: Explicit funding/outcome reconciliation and approved financial retention migration before account erasure.
classes.exportPolicy: Future customer-funded approvals and charges only; provider result content uses applicable content/privacy scope, global budget and log IDs excluded.

classes.purpose: Customer usage appeals, private operator investigations and metadata-only churn observation.
classes.currentRetention: Removed-project observations expire after 90 days; investigations/customer requests have no general purge and cascade with account. Monitor is nonblocking.
classes.proposedRetention: Proposed 90 days after resolution/removal for necessary metadata, with explicit open-case review. Closure/export must remain available regardless of usage concerns.
classes.deletionAuthority: Customer closure and qualified review operator; minimum unresolved case handling cannot retain unrelated site/chat content by default.
classes.exportPolicy: Customer's submitted request and customer-visible response; exclude private operator investigation details and model context copies.

classes.purpose: Site health receipts and content-free daily request totals.
classes.currentRetention: Health checks older than 30 days and traffic older than the 30-day UTC window are pruned. Account/project cascades remove remaining rows.
classes.proposedRetention: Keep existing windows initially. Account closure purges linkable rows; only truly non-identifying platform aggregates may survive.
classes.deletionAuthority: Documented automatic retention or reviewed account/project closure.
classes.exportPolicy: Owned daily totals and customer-visible health results, not raw request logs or visitor identifiers.

classes.purpose: Shared product policy, aggregate counters and operator coordination/health.
classes.currentRetention: Shared singleton/period metadata; health budget older than 62 days is pruned. No per-customer deletion authority.
classes.proposedRetention: Retain platform configuration and bounded aggregate operating records; never put raw personal data or credentials into these global rows.
classes.deletionAuthority: Operator maintenance only; account closure never deletes shared platform resources or policy.
classes.exportPolicy: Only applicable public plan/policy version; no internal aggregate costs, locks or cross-account state.
